The '''HF-2''' was a model of [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]] manufactured by [[SakTek, Inc.]] and used by many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who appreciated its functionality and the variety of ways in which it could be upgraded. HF-2s sold for 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and could carry two passengers.<ref name="LoNH" />
